title: Skull Cap Anthracite

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Daytona Skull Cap Anthracite is crafted for riders seeking low-profile styling with DOT baseline compliance, pairing low-profile styling with essential certified head protection. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at 1464g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~100 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT impact standards. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Round Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: Ultra-slim DOT half helmet — one of the smallest profiles available.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Open-face design; fits standard head shapes but lacks internal retention systems for safety certification.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Daytona Skull Cap Anthracite: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Daytona's Half lineup, the Skull Cap Anthracite brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for a Round Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT track safety.
story:
The Daytona Skull Cap Anthracite represents Daytona's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~100 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Half helmet tailored to a Round Oval head shape, the Daytona Skull Cap Anthracite delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
